title: Popular Treatment Areas
subtitle: We select optimal treatment solutions based on diagnosis, budget, and patient preferences. Here are some of the most in-demand areas:

kidney-treatment.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Kidney Diseases
kidney-treatment.text: Comprehensive kidney check-up and treatment: ultrasound, lab tests, nephrologist consultations. Personalized therapy in top-tier clinics in Istanbul.

checkup.title: Comprehensive One-Day Check-Up
checkup.text: Full body examination: lab tests, ultrasound, consultations with a general practitioner and specialists. Fast, convenient, and accurate.

surgery.title: Modern Surgery in Turkey
surgery.text: Organization of surgical procedures: from planning to rehabilitation. Advanced equipment, experienced surgeons, and personalized care.

oncology.title: Oncology: Diagnosis and Treatment
oncology.text: Proven diagnostic methods, targeted therapy, chemo- and radiotherapy. Support from the first step to the complete course.

ivf.title: IVF and Reproductive Medicine
ivf.text: IVF programs and support for families dreaming of a child. High success rates, certified clinics, and care at every stage.

cardiology.title: Cardiology: Diagnostics and Treatment
cardiology.text: Heart ultrasound, coronary angiography, treatment of arrhythmias and ischemia. In collaboration with Turkey’s leading cardiologists.

spine.title: Spine Treatment and Back Pain Relief
spine.text: MRI diagnostics, consultations with neurosurgeons, minimally invasive surgeries, and rehabilitation. Pain-free path to a new life.

rehabilitation.title: Post-Surgery and Injury Rehabilitation
rehabilitation.text: Recovery programs under the guidance of physiotherapists and rehabilitation specialists. Personalized, effective, and caring.

gynecology.title: Women’s Health and Gynecology
gynecology.text: Diagnosis, treatment, and surgery for gynecological conditions. Modern equipment and support from female doctors.
